segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company seeking an initial business combination with one or more target businesses in any industry or geography.
segments.evidence: The CODM assesses performance for the single segment and decides how to allocate resources based on net income or loss that also is reported on the statement of operations as net income or loss.

revenueModel.text: No operating revenue; the company earns none until it completes an initial business combination.
revenueModel.evidence: We have generated no revenues to date and we do not expect that we will generate operating revenues until, at the earliest, we consummate our initial business combination.
